title: Enhance resume analyzer with comprehensive extraction and advanced features

requirements.summary: Replace mock AI parsing with comprehensive extraction capturing contact information, professional summary, certifications with issuing organizations and dates, and languages with proficiency levels
acceptanceCriteria: Contact information section displays phone, email, LinkedIn URL, and location when present in resume
Professional summary is extracted and displayed as a separate section
Certifications include issuing organization and date fields
Languages are extracted with proficiency levels (Basic, Intermediate, Fluent, Native)

file_operations.description: Remove mock data generation and implement comprehensive extraction logic that parses resume content to capture: contact information (phone regex patterns, email patterns, LinkedIn URL patterns, location extraction), professional summary (typically first paragraph or section labeled 'Summary'/'Objective'), certifications with structured fields (name, issuing organization, issue date, expiration date), and languages with proficiency levels mapped to standardized levels (Basic, Intermediate, Fluent, Native)

Enhance pattern matching to identify and extract: contact information patterns (phone numbers with international formats, email addresses, LinkedIn URLs, location/address patterns), professional summary section (common headers like 'Summary', 'Profile', 'Objective'), certifications section with organization and date patterns, and languages section with proficiency indicators

Add new sections to display: Contact Information card with phone, email, LinkedIn link, and location fields; Professional Summary card showing extracted summary text; enhanced Certifications section displaying certification name, issuing organization, and dates in a structured format; Languages section with proficiency level badges (Basic, Intermediate, Fluent, Native) using color coding

requirements.summary: Enhance work experience parsing to extract detailed information including job titles, company names, employment dates with start and end, location, and bullet-point descriptions
acceptanceCriteria: Each work experience entry displays company name, job title, location, and date range
Employment dates are parsed into structured start and end date fields
Job descriptions are extracted as an array of bullet points
Work experience entries are displayed in reverse chronological order

file_operations.description: Enhance work experience extraction to capture: job title patterns (typically bold or prominent text), company names (often followed by location or date ranges), employment dates with start and end parsing (handle formats like 'Jan 2020 - Dec 2022', '2020-2022', 'Present', 'Current'), location extraction for each position, and bullet-point descriptions (identify lines starting with bullets, dashes, or similar markers)

Update work experience data structure to include: company name, job title, location, startDate and endDate as separate fields (parse into month/year format), and descriptions as an array of bullet-point strings. Sort entries by start date in descending order for reverse chronological display

Redesign work experience section to display each entry with: company name as primary heading, job title as secondary heading, location and date range on a single line, and bullet-point descriptions rendered as an unordered list. Ensure entries are displayed in reverse chronological order

requirements.summary: Implement resume scoring and analysis system evaluating completeness, content quality, formatting consistency, and skill relevance, displaying overall score out of 100 with category breakdown
acceptanceCriteria: Overall resume score is calculated and displayed as a percentage out of 100
Score breakdown shows individual category scores: Completeness, Content Quality, Formatting, and Skill Relevance
Each category includes specific feedback explaining the score
Scoring algorithm awards points for complete sections, detailed descriptions, quantifiable achievements, and in-demand skills

file_operations.description: Create scoring service that evaluates: Completeness (25 points - checks presence of all major sections: contact, summary, experience, education, skills), Content Quality (25 points - analyzes description detail length, identifies quantifiable achievements using regex patterns for numbers/percentages/metrics), Formatting (25 points - checks consistency in date formats, bullet point usage, section structure), and Skill Relevance (25 points - matches skills against in-demand skill database or categories). Return overall score and per-category breakdown with specific feedback strings

Add Resume Score section at the top of the results page displaying: large circular or bar progress indicator for overall score out of 100, four category cards showing Completeness, Content Quality, Formatting, and Skill Relevance scores with individual progress bars, and specific feedback text for each category explaining why points were awarded or deducted
Integrate resumeScoring service to calculate scores after parsing resume data and include score results in the parsed resume object returned to components

requirements.summary: Redesign results display page with modern, professional UI featuring card-based layout, clear visual hierarchy, section headers with icons, improved typography, color-coded skill tags, and responsive design
acceptanceCriteria: Results page uses a clean card-based layout with consistent spacing and shadows
Each major section (Contact, Summary, Experience, Education, Skills, Certifications) has a clear header with an appropriate icon
Skills are displayed as color-coded tags grouped by category
Layout is fully responsive and usable on mobile devices
Typography follows a clear hierarchy with appropriate font sizes and weights

file_operations.description: Completely redesign the layout with: Card component from shadcn/ui for each major section with consistent padding and shadow, section headers using Heading components with imported icons from lucide-react (User for Contact, FileText for Summary, Briefcase for Experience, GraduationCap for Education, Code for Skills, Award for Certifications), responsive grid layout using Tailwind CSS classes (stack on mobile, multi-column on desktop), improved typography hierarchy with text-2xl for page title, text-xl for section headers, text-base for content, and proper font-weight classes

Create reusable component for displaying skills as color-coded tags: Technical skills use blue badges, Soft skills use green badges, Domain skills use purple badges. Group skills by category with category headers. Use Badge component from shadcn/ui with appropriate variant classes. Include proficiency level indicator (dot or mini-badge) within each skill tag
Replace current skills display with SkillTagDisplay component, passing categorized skills data. Ensure the component is responsive and wraps tags properly on smaller screens

Add or refine CSS custom properties for the results page theme if needed, ensuring sufficient contrast for accessibility and professional appearance. Verify existing card shadow and spacing variables are appropriate for the redesigned layout

requirements.summary: Enhance education section extraction to capture degree type, field of study, institution name, graduation date, GPA, and relevant coursework or honors
acceptanceCriteria: Each education entry displays degree type and field of study
Institution name and graduation date are extracted and displayed
GPA is captured and displayed when present in the resume
Relevant coursework and honors are extracted as separate fields when available

file_operations.description: Enhance education extraction patterns to identify: degree type (Bachelor, Master, PhD, Associate, etc.), field of study (often follows degree type, e.g., 'Bachelor of Science in Computer Science'), institution name (university/college name), graduation date (year or month/year format), GPA (patterns like '3.8/4.0', 'GPA: 3.8'), relevant coursework (section labeled 'Relevant Coursework' or bullet points under education), and honors (Dean's List, Cum Laude, scholarships)

Update education data structure to include fields: degreeType, fieldOfStudy, institution, graduationDate, gpa (optional), coursework (array of strings, optional), and honors (array of strings, optional). Parse and structure these fields from extracted text

Redesign education section to display each entry with: degree type and field of study as main heading (e.g., 'Bachelor of Science in Computer Science'), institution name and graduation date on the next line, GPA displayed prominently if present, relevant coursework shown as a comma-separated list or bullet points, and honors displayed with badge or emphasized text styling

requirements.summary: Improve skills extraction to categorize skills into Technical, Soft, and Domain categories, with automatic proficiency level inference based on years of experience and context
acceptanceCriteria: Skills are automatically categorized into Technical, Soft, and Domain categories
Proficiency levels (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced) are inferred from context and experience duration
Skills display includes visual indicators for proficiency level
Each skill category is displayed in a separate, clearly labeled section

file_operations.description: Enhance skill categorization logic: maintain predefined lists or pattern matching for Technical skills (programming languages, frameworks, tools), Soft skills (communication, leadership, teamwork, problem-solving), and Domain skills (industry-specific knowledge like finance, healthcare, marketing). Implement proficiency inference: parse years of experience from work history, map experience duration to proficiency levels (0-2 years = Beginner, 2-5 years = Intermediate, 5+ years = Advanced), look for context clues in descriptions (e.g., 'proficient in', 'expert in', 'familiar with')

Enhance component to display proficiency levels: add a small badge or colored dot within each skill tag indicating proficiency (green dot for Advanced, yellow for Intermediate, gray for Beginner). Ensure each category (Technical, Soft, Domain) is displayed in a separate section with a clear category header and appropriate icon

Ensure SkillTagDisplay component receives categorized skills with proficiency levels and is integrated into the redesigned layout. Verify that Technical, Soft, and Domain skills are visually separated and clearly labeled
